t: 康邦-汉萨瓦底战争结束,缅甸内战结束(1740–1757年).
te: The end of Konbaung–Hanthawaddy War, and the end of Burmese Civil War (1740–1757).
dz: 康邦-汉萨瓦底战争结束,缅甸内战结束(1740–1757年).
de: The end of Konbaung–Hanthawaddy War, and the end of Burmese Civil War (1740–1757).

t: 一门普鲁士军队在七年战争中与一门奥地利军队在布拉格会战.
te: A Prussian army fights an Austrian army in Prague during the Seven Years' War.
dz: 布拉格之战:一门普鲁士军队在七年战争中与一门奥地利军队在布拉格会战.
de: Battle of Prague: A Prussian army fights an Austrian army in Prague during the Seven Years' War.

t: 法国路易十四将宫廷迁至凡尔赛宫。
te: Louis XIV of France moves his court to the Palace of Versailles.
dz: 法国路易十四将宫廷迁至凡尔赛宫。
de: Louis XIV of France moves his court to the Palace of Versailles.

t: 英军一派罢免理查德·克伦威尔为英联邦护国勋爵并重新组建鲁普议会.
te: A faction of the British Army removes Richard Cromwell as Lord Protector of the Commonwealth and reinstalls the Rump Pa…
dz: 英军复辟:英军一派罢免理查德·克伦威尔为英联邦护国勋爵并重新组建鲁普议会.
de: English Restoration: A faction of the British Army removes Richard Cromwell as Lord Protector of the Commonwealth and reinstalls the Rump Parliament.

t: 被西班牙人所持有的荷兰城市"克夫登"(Coevorden)倒下为一股荷兰和英国势力.
te: The Dutch city of Coevorden, held by the Spanish, falls to a Dutch and English force.
dz: 被西班牙人所持有的荷兰城市"克夫登"(Coevorden)倒下为一股荷兰和英国势力.
de: The Dutch city of Coevorden, held by the Spanish, falls to a Dutch and English force.

t: Francis Xavier到达了当时葡萄牙印度的首都Old Goa.
te: Francis Xavier reaches Old Goa, the capital of Portuguese India at the time.
dz: Francis Xavier到达了当时葡萄牙印度的首都Old Goa.
de: Francis Xavier reaches Old Goa, the capital of Portuguese India at the time.

t: 国王亨利八世下令在每个教堂放置英文圣经。 1539 年，伟大的圣经将为此目的而提供。
te: King Henry VIII orders English-language Bibles be placed in every church. In 1539 the Great Bible would be provided for…
dz: 国王亨利八世下令在每个教堂放置英文圣经。 1539 年，伟大的圣经将为此目的而提供。
de: King Henry VIII orders English-language Bibles be placed in every church. In 1539 the Great Bible would be provided for this purpose.

t: 库斯科之围开始,其中因坎部队试图从西班牙人手中夺回库斯科城.
te: The Siege of Cuzco commences, in which Incan forces attempt to retake the city of Cuzco from the Spanish.
dz: 库斯科之围开始,其中因坎部队试图从西班牙人手中夺回库斯科城.
de: The Siege of Cuzco commences, in which Incan forces attempt to retake the city of Cuzco from the Spanish.

t: 西班牙和德军打包罗马;许多学者认为这是文艺复兴的终结.
te: Spanish and German troops sack Rome; many scholars consider this the end of the Renaissance.
dz: 西班牙和德军打包罗马;许多学者认为这是文艺复兴的终结.
de: Spanish and German troops sack Rome; many scholars consider this the end of the Renaissance.

t: 耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世开始围攻阿克里,后被法蒂米德人所控制.
te: King Baldwin I of Jerusalem begins the siege of Acre, then held by the Fatimids.
dz: 耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世开始围攻阿克里,后被法蒂米德人所控制.
de: King Baldwin I of Jerusalem begins the siege of Acre, then held by the Fatimids.
